dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular ring structures with high-contrast, light-colored perimeters and dark interiors. Most prominent structures are located on the dorsal-anterior region, characterized by varying edge thickness and semi-closed 'C' or closed 'O' shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Localized clusters of small, high-intensity light pixels lacking internal gradients are distributed across the lateral mid-section and neck area, with a higher concentration observed on the lower visible flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a non-equilateral quadrilateral pattern. A secondary linear alignment of three smaller high-intensity blobs is visible along the lower lateral boundary.
